overview.en: Platyla polita is a tiny, operculate land snail with a broad but patchy European range.
overview.fr: Platyla polita est un minuscule escargot terrestre à opercule, largement répandu en Europe mais de façon discontinue.

identification.en: Its smooth, glossy reddish-brown shell is elongated and tower-shaped, usually under 4 mm high.
identification.fr: Sa coquille lisse, brillante et brun rougeâtre est allongée et en forme de tour ; elle mesure généralement moins de 4 mm.

habitat.en: It lives in damp woodland litter, moss and decaying wood, often on moist, base-rich ground.
habitat.fr: Elle vit dans la litière des bois humides, les mousses et le bois mort, souvent sur des sols frais riches en bases.

diet.en: The species accounts consulted do not describe its diet in detail.
diet.fr: Les fiches consultées ne décrivent pas précisément son régime alimentaire.

behavior.en: It hides in litter and wood mould; in Latvia it is active in the growing season and overwinters below litter.
behavior.fr: Elle se cache dans la litière et l’humus du bois ; en Lettonie, elle est active durant la végétation et hiverne sous la litière.

reproduction.en: It has separate sexes; little else is known about its reproduction.
reproduction.fr: Les sexes sont séparés ; le reste de sa reproduction est peu connu.

ecology.en: In eastern France it also occurs under dead wood and among scree in cool deciduous forests.
ecology.fr: Dans l’est de la France, elle se rencontre aussi sous le bois mort et dans les éboulis de forêts fraîches de feuillus.

conservation.en: In 2023 Latvia assessed it as Vulnerable nationally, but Least Concern globally and in Europe.
conservation.fr: En 2023, la Lettonie l’a classée vulnérable au niveau national, mais en préoccupation mineure dans le monde et en Europe.

title.en: Platyla polita: distribution and ecology in Europe and Germany — German Malacological Society
title.fr: Platyla polita : répartition et écologie en Europe et en Allemagne — Société malacologique allemande

facts: The German-language malacological study documents a broad but discontinuous European range and association with moist, base-rich woodland, litter and dead wood.

title.fr: Aiguillette lisse — Livre rouge de Lettonie

facts: Latvian account gives shell traits, concealed habits, activity and reproduction; diet is not detailed.
The Latvian Red Data Book distinguishes country-level Vulnerable from global and European Least Concern.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Aiguillette luisante — Atlas des mollusques méconnus de Bourgogne–Franche-Comté
title.fr: Smooth needle snail — atlas of little-known molluscs in Bourgogne–Franche-Comté

facts: The French atlas reports the snail in cool deciduous woodland litter, under dead wood and in scree in eastern France.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Diet details and many aspects of reproduction remain poorly documented in the reviewed sources.
The Latvian national category must not be generalized to the whole species range.
review_note: Cross-checked a German specialist malacological study, a French regional atlas and the Latvian Red Data Book; kept conservation categories at their stated geographic scales.
